answer: One workable design: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because grove only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. In practice violet is enforced by the ledger itself: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any bridge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
